Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the Lumos ACH form and the voided check. Next steps from finance: 
1) We will run the routing/account verification via our banking partner. If verification can't be completed electronically, we will trigger a pair of micro-deposits (standard small amounts) to the account.
2) Please note we require one additional proof-of-account document (bank letter or account statement with last 4 digits) for our compliance file. Can Lumos provide that?
3) I will open FIN-3421 and track completion there.

We typically hold off on issuing the PO until micro-deposit verification completes to avoid misdirected payments. If Redwood needs to expedite (e.g., initial prepayment), let me know and we can discuss a wire with additional sign-off.

I'll update when the bank returns verification or when the micro-deposits are scheduled.

- Michael
